extracted.intended_audience: students and instructors of second- and third-year German courses; general library users
extracted.subtask_description: Catalog/item page describing a cultural/literary reader textbook for intermediate (second- and third-year) German learners, summarizing content, organization, and pedagogical features. Used to inform instructors/students about the book's suitability and contents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diverse selection of text types
rubrics_metrics.description: This cultural/literary reader includes over eighty selections. A wide variety of text types is represented, among them: biographical and autobiographical passages, essays, cartoons, newspaper reports and magazine articles, advertisements, short stories, poems, short entries from reference works, excerpts from novels and novellas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many selections are presented in their original format; the variety is intended to expose students to multiple genres and registers of contemporary German.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization according to central themes
rubrics_metrics.description: Organized according to four central themes: Individuum und die Gesellschaft (Zur Person; Die Frau; Deutschland), Kommunikation (Sprache; Familie; Medien), Lebensqualität (Schule und Universität; Arbeit; Freizeit), Mensch und seine Umwelt (Gesundheit und Fitness; Technik; Umwelt).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The thematic organization presents diverse perspectives on contemporary German culture and groups readings to support thematic instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-reading, reading, and post-reading activities for each selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Each selection is accompanied by pre-reading, reading and post-reading activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These staged activities scaffold comprehension and classroom use of each text, supporting preparatory work, in-class reading, and follow-up tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partner and group activities to foster communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Numerous partner and group activities encourage student interaction and foster communication skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes communicative pedagogy—activities are designed for interaction rather than only individual work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Variety of activities to support vocabulary acquisition and analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: A wide variety of activities supports vocabulary acquisition and analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Activities target both lexis (vocabulary building) and analytical skills (text analysis), indicating multiple modes of practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introductory material in English
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides orientation/context in English to assist learners at the intermediate level with background or pedagogical instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: German–English vocabulary included
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A bilingual glossary supports learner comprehension and vocabulary study.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeted course level
rubrics_metrics.description: [The book is] for students in second- and third-year German courses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies intended proficiency/academic level—useful for instructors selecting materials appropriate to students' stage.
